insights.title: Idle app repaints 21 frames/s
insights.detail: With nothing happening the app still writes 10.5 KB/s to the terminal and uses 2.7% of a core. Ambient work is dominated by _tui_api._clock_run (19 ms/3 s), tui.set_text (15 ms/3 s), _tui._calc_bounds (14 ms/3 s). 45% of it is forks and external programs.

insights.title: Input handling spawns processes on 10 interaction types
insights.detail: Hover, focus and click should be fork-free (a fork costs ~1 ms, an awk ~4 ms). Command palette close: 12.0 forks + 6.0 programs; Mouse click: 5.0 forks + 2.2 programs; Command palette open: 5.0 forks + 2.0 programs; Wheel scroll, single: 4.0 forks + 2.0 programs; Wheel scroll, burst: 3.0 forks + 1.5 programs.

insights.title: alt+2 does not switch pages on a warm start
insights.detail: The demo binds alt+1..0 in _nav.xml, but the key is dispatched with no binding found (handled in <1 ms, no page change). Mouse navigation works.
